strategy.primary: Borrow an opponent's best creature every combat, swing with it, then sacrifice it before cleanup: Edea returns it to its owner and draws you a card while your sacrifice payoffs (Goblin Bombardment, Mayhem Devil, Grave Pact) fire.
strategy.secondary: Multiply the theft (Mass Mutiny, Insurrection, Captivating Crew, extra combats, Edea copies) and convert temporary theft into permanent value (Thassa, Nightmare Shepherd, Black Crystal, Saw in Half, Impostor Syndrome).

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: Edea, Possessed Sorceress

identity.why: Free combat theft plus a card whenever the borrowed creature dies.
Turns a one-turn steal into a permanent one.
Free outlet that also turns each borrowed body into damage.
Steals one creature from every opponent at once.
Keeps the stolen creature's card for later.
